text:
viv (PM): Quick sync: customer 'FinAdept' asked for route-level quant/batch/cache recs but they're risk-averse. Propose a phased launch: Phase 1 = read-only recs + eval alerts; Phase 2 = canary apply; Phase 3 = autopilot. Thoughts?
noah (PM): Phased approach makes sense. We should define clear metrics per phase. Phase 1 success = recs generated for top 15 routes and customers validate rec rationale. Phase 2 success = canary passes SLOs for 24h on 5 routes. Phase 3 gated on pilot acceptance.
isha (Eng): Feasibility notes: batching heuristics are straightforward if we have per-route seq-length histograms and peak concurrency. Cache recs need payload classification; we can only recommend caching when we can compute deterministic keys. Quant recs require offline sample-based evaluation — that'll be heavier.
martin (DataSci): For eval-triggered alerts: we can compute a delta score and show example outputs. Recommend 300 prompts for stability on production routes but 100 for small-volume routes. We'll show bootstrap CI, effect size, and human-review flag.
helen (SRE): Canary policy: default canary 3% traffic for 6h; escalate to 10% if stable. SLOs to monitor: p95 latency, 5xx rate, GPU mem usage. Auto-rollback thresholds need to be strict for pilot customers (e.g., >10% p95 increase or >2x error rate).
ticket-bot: Created TASK-4321 advisor-phased-launch.
viv (PM): Draft launch criteria for product doc: 1) UI lists recs with cost/latency/quality deltas and reasoning 2) eval-triggered alerts implemented 3) canary apply with runbook and auto-rollback 4) admin controls and audit logs 5) pilot customers on boarded.
noah (PM): Add owner list and timelines: - Isha: backend API for recs + explanation strings (10d) - Martin: eval harness + sample sets (14d) - Helen: canary runbook + ops toggles (7d) - Viv/Noah: pilot coordination + success criteria doc (7d)
isha (Eng): Also: hide quant recs behind a feature flag and only show for supported model families. We should include an explicit 'needs offline eval' state in UI.
martin (DataSci): We'll provide a small UI widget to compare baseline vs suggested outputs side-by-side for review. Also propose email digest for scheduled recs.
helen (SRE): Add an SLO checklist for canary acceptance: no SLO breach for 24h, no memory growth > 5%, and error budget use < 10% during canary.
viv (PM): Good. Prioritization: advisor-lite Q3 (batch+cache+alerts), full advisor Q4 (add quant + autopilot). If no blockers I'll create the GH epic and invite folks to kickoff tomorrow.
